value.rationale: The exact constraint on all d+1 prescribed Gaussian centers gives implementable minimal-window designs, an iff failure locus and computable all-dimensional frame bounds that are not supplied by general existence theorems. The sharp quadratic collapse constant quantifies unavoidable instability at a natural geometric boundary and distinguishes qualitative existence from robust frame design. Scope excludes arbitrary lattices and does not merely substitute a named parameter into the known rN>d theorem.
